levels.label: Repository-declared policy
levels.allowed_claim: The board reads a repository-owned manifest with gate commands, dependencies, and mutation classes.
levels.forbidden_inference: The board is the source of policy for every repository or hosted CI system.

levels.label: Explicit non-mutating run
levels.allowed_claim: The local board blocks a dependent gate until its prerequisite passes, then records bounded read-only results.
levels.forbidden_inference: Every declared command is safe or every run is equivalent to hosted CI.

levels.label: Target-bound continuation
levels.allowed_claim: Successful runs write local receipts tied to the observed Git target revision.
levels.forbidden_inference: The receipt proves a hosted check or external deployment.

levels.label: Current dev checkpoint
levels.status_display: Syntax receipt and dependent blocking reproduce
levels.allowed_claim: The current dev CLI loads the declaration, writes a syntax receipt, and keeps dependent gates blocked until prerequisite state is handed off.
levels.forbidden_inference: Separate CLI invocations continue a passed gate sequence or provide Flight Recorder parity.

levels.label: Trace and state coverage
levels.status_display: Flight Recorder and stale matrix pending
levels.allowed_claim: The local receipt contract is a seam for future trace integration.
levels.forbidden_inference: Parent/child causality, concurrent refresh, and all stale/failed states have passed.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The Gateboard case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
